payload.feature:
This worktree carries decision 0041 rulings 1 to 3 as delivered by run decision-0041-docs-decisions-004-8a6fb3e6 (commits 605e58a, 691045c, 62ee1bb on top of main 484d243). That run stopped at REVIEW-RESIDUAL-ABOVE-MEDIUM on one HIGH correctness finding, with one LOW beside it. This slice answers exactly those two findings on top of the existing commits and nothing else; read the decision (docs/decisions/0041-one-office-per-seat.md, rulings 1 to 3) for the law the earlier commits enact, and keep every property they established.

The HIGH finding, quoted from the review seat: "The implementer offices can no longer commit. agents/implementer.json, implementer-engine.json and implementer-speckit.json grant only `cargo`, but charters/implementer.md orders 'Commit your work' and reports `complete` only when committed. Through adapters/claude.json that resolves to `--allowedTools Bash(cargo:*)` in headless -p mode under acceptEdits, so `git add`/`git commit` are refused. Every recipe that seats the library implementer loses its commit: bundles/self, panel-review, ember, sdd, sdd-paranoid and crucible via implementer-engine; adoption.rs even pins the broken argv. The commission removed python3/pytest and un-invoked specify; roster.rs's `charter.contains(tool)` substring heuristic then stripped git because the charter says 'commit' rather than 'git'."

Fix it so: restore `git` in the allow-list of agents/implementer.json, agents/implementer-engine.json and agents/implementer-speckit.json (and any other agent whose charter commits or reads git history — intake reads the tree with git, positions read code, the chief-architect commits its spec, the shipper runs `git status` and `git log`; check each charter honestly). Make the roster test's "a tool grant no library charter invokes" check recognise an invocation by what the charter asks the seat to do, not by a substring: name `git` explicitly in each charter's commit or history line (for example "commit your work with git" and "read `git log`/`git diff`") and let the test look for the tool's name as a word; write the forced reading into the test's comment. Re-pin whatever moved and say why in the test's own words: the resolved argv assertions in crates/brokkr-runtime/tests/adoption.rs (restore element-for-element assertions of the tool list rather than `iter().any`; drop the dead `specify` column), the witness digests in crates/brokkr-runtime/tests/witness_digests.rs, the compose pins, and the recipe digest list in docs/guides/recipe-authoring.md.

The LOW finding, quoted: "reviewer.json, review-correctness.json and review-spec-compliance.json keep `tools.allow: ["git"]` beside `hands`. The resolver never consults `allow` when `hands` is set and 0043 ruling 2 says hands replace the tool list." Remove the dead `tools.allow` from every agent that declares `hands`, or, if the loader requires the key, leave it empty and say so in the agent-library guide; decision 0043 ruling 5 said the review agents "keep their tool grants for the record" — the record is the journal, not a dead field, so removing it is consistent with 0043's ruling 2; state the reading in the roster test's comment.

Prove it end to end: a test in crates/brokkr-runtime/tests/roster.rs (or adoption.rs) resolves the library implementer through the shipped claude adapter and asserts `Bash(git:*)` is in its `--allowedTools`, so the defect cannot return silently; and the existing property tests of the earlier commits (night-shift's one-attempt bounds, the two-families panel rule with its forced reading stated, the judges refusal on every link) stay green.

Constraints: the exact coverage gate (scripts/coverage-exact.sh, run with stdin closed: </dev/null) must stay at literal 100%; clippy -D warnings and fmt must stay clean; cargo test --workspace green; contracts/, fixtures/ and policy/phase-machine.json are read-only and this slice needs no contract change; the decision index docs/decisions/README.md must keep every row main carries in number order; do not name the private neighbours in prose; keep the CLI list "claude, codex or dsh" whenever a list of harnesses appears; commit in the repository's style on top of the existing commits and never push.

result.notes: Restored explicit Git grants and charter invocations for library implementer and intake seats, removed ignored tool lists beside boxed hands, added end-to-end Claude argv coverage, and re-pinned affected identities. Workspace tests, clippy -D warnings, fmt, and exact 100% coverage are green; committed as b4daeaa.

Verified at HEAD b4daeaa on fire/0041-roster, clean tree, nothing changed. (1) `cargo test --workspace`: 51 test binaries plus doc-tests, every result line `ok`, 1023 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored. Includes machine_proof (56), differential (3), wager_parity (3), witness_digests (3), adoption (6), roster (5). Roster carries the end-to-end proof the slice asked for: shipped_claude_implementer_can_commit, tool_grants_are_invoked_by_the_library_and_effort_never_rises_on_fallback, night_shift_keeps_one_attempt_on_every_roster_gate, every_shipped_panel_seats_at_least_two_model_families, shipped_model_sites_name_the_library_outside_the_ruled_exceptions — all green. Adoption's five resolved-argv tests green with the dead specify column gone (the_speckit_check_step_stays_inline remains). (2) `cargo run -p brokkr-cli -- compile --bundle bundles/self`: exit 0, bundle digest ac0fc141…cb319, engine 0.8.0, five seats resolved (implement→implementer/opus, intake/sonnet, review→reviewer/fable with workspace hands, ship/fable, verify/fable), notices empty on every seat, no lint output.

Reviewed b4daeaa on top of 605e58a/691045c/62ee1bb (main 484d243). Correctness: the HIGH is closed — implementer, implementer-engine and implementer-speckit grant cargo+git; intake and intake-speckit grant git; chief-architect keeps git+specify and shipper git, each charter naming the tool as a word (commit 'with `git`', 'git log'/'git diff'); positions, verifier, muninn, triage checked honestly and need no git. The new roster test compiles bundles/self through the shipped claude adapter and asserts Bash(git:*) in --allowedTools; adoption.rs asserts the resolved argv element-for-element (the iter().any that hid the tool list was the model check in 605e58a, already replaced in 62ee1bb, now documented). specify is not dead — the chief-architect invokes it — so keeping that column is right. Every moved pin (compose UNCOMPOSED + composed golden, adoption rosters, library_data charters, witness digests, recipe-authoring digest list) is re-pinned with its reason stated in the test. LOW closed: tools.allow removed from reviewer, review-correctness and review-spec-compliance; the roster test forbids tools beside hands and states the 0043 ruling-2/ruling-5 reading; the loader does not require the key. Earlier properties stay green (night-shift one attempt, two-families panel rule, judges gate). Simplicity: no dead policy or code; names_word is the smallest honest check. Security: none — grants are strictly narrower than main's (main gave implementers python3/pytest/ls/rg/mkdir/codex/dsh), tool names resolve only through the adapter's fixed map so charters cannot inject argv, no journal, protocol, contract, fixture or secret path touched; the adapter judges list from the earlier commits fails closed when absent. Gates run from this seat: cargo fmt --check clean, clippy -D warnings clean, cargo test --workspace green with zero failure lines. scripts/coverage-exact.sh is refused by the seat sandbox; HEAD changes no production source (only tests, agents and docs), so the verify phase's coverage pass stands. Decision index untouched and in order; no CLI list added; no private neighbour named. Tree clean, no fixes applied, nothing pushed.

Shipper prepare step. Tree clean, HEAD b4daeaa on fire/0041-roster over main 484d243. Ledger written to .forge/ledger/this-worktree-carries-decision-0-116999ea.md (gitignored, not committed). Delivered: commit b4daeaa closes the HIGH (git restored on the three implementer offices plus intake/intake-speckit, charters name git as a word, roster test matches the tool name as a word with the forced reading in its comment, adoption argv re-pinned element-for-element, witness/compose/library-data/recipe-authoring digests re-pinned with reasons) and the LOW (tools.allow removed beside hands on reviewer, review-correctness, review-spec-compliance; reading of 0043 rulings 2 and 5 stated in the roster test). New end-to-end test shipped_claude_implementer_can_commit asserts Bash(git:*) in --allowedTools through the shipped claude adapter. Verify at b4daeaa: 1023 passed, 0 failed, self bundle compiles (digest ac0fc141…cb319). Review: clean, no fixes. Coverage 100% witnessed by the implement seat; the review seat could not run the script from its sandbox and HEAD touches no production source. Operator next: review the four commits (b4daeaa is the only new one), optionally re-run scripts/coverage-exact.sh </dev/null, then push and merge. No push, no commit by this seat.

Shipper close-out. Nothing moved since the ledger was written: git status --porcelain is empty and HEAD is still b4daeaa, the commit the ledger records over main 484d243. Shipped on fire/0041-roster: commit b4daeaa closing the HIGH (git restored on the three implementer offices plus intake and intake-speckit; charters name git as a word; roster test matches the tool name as a word with the forced reading stated; adoption argv re-pinned element-for-element; witness, compose, library-data and recipe-authoring digests re-pinned with reasons) and the LOW (dead tools.allow removed beside hands on reviewer, review-correctness and review-spec-compliance; reading of 0043 rulings 2 and 5 stated in the roster test). New end-to-end test shipped_claude_implementer_can_commit proves Bash(git:*) reaches --allowedTools through the shipped claude adapter. Verify at b4daeaa: 1023 passed, 0 failed; self bundle compiles. Review clean, no residual debt from this run. Ledger at .forge/ledger/this-worktree-carries-decision-0-116999ea.md (gitignored). Operator next: review the four commits (b4daeaa is the only new one), optionally re-run scripts/coverage-exact.sh </dev/null for an independent 100% witness, then push and open the PR against main. No seat pushed, no commit made in this phase.
